body:

**Advisor council**: Advait Rane, Vismay Joshi, ash|inthewild

**General updates: **

The Diversification Fund has been active for a bit over a month since the passing and subsequent dispersion of funds to the Financial WG multisig wallet (Proposal 54 on Commonwealth - subscan link: [https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury/54](https://edgeware.subscan.io/treasury/54)). Since then the overall macro trend across the industry is sideways action with some tokens trending downwards and receiving some floor support. This period has resulted in the Diversification Fund team to re-review our overall allocation to various ecosystems, tokens and strategies for growth across the fund. 


**Fund updates + strategy: **

After receiving the EDG, the advisors have converted the EDG into stablecoin (USDT) to shield the fund from any negative market related fluctuations of the initial capital, we chose USDT opposed to other stablecoins due to universal accessibility across CEX’s and DEX’s. 
We have determined that the fund will seek exposure across 3 ecosystems w/ specific sectors: 
1. Ethereum
2. Defi 
3. Money market
4. Synthetics
5. Dex’s
6. Metaverse / Gaming. 
7. Polkadot
8. Cosmos
9. TBD


![](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/i_o1_UQuJ8QOo2avcrCn5OFkhUgGcz2KyZ_QmogGJHGZICKvq1CJUU_eHHwOb-QPoIM5SGc62Kvd2gZ9H2-pKGam9x5YLHb8-KYSvbkzpYzlxfBD1VBKA3ZWQGGT4NICUcxVTYMM7M5FfBKzPw)

Each ecosystem will have specific projects that are to be allocated to each sector; our preliminary allocation across ecosystems is: Ethereum (40%), Polkadot (20%), Cosmos (30%), TBD (10%).
